==Walkthrough==
===Getting started===
{{Checklist|*Talk to [[Reldo]], located in the library in [[Varrock Palace]]. {{Chat option|1I'm in search of a quest.}}
*Check the [[bookcase (Shield of Arrav)|bookcase]] with a bright blue book in the top shelf, and read the book.
*Talk to Reldo again.
After this point, you must choose to join either the [[Phoenix Gang]] or the [[Black Arm Gang]]. ('''Tip:''' Join the [[chat-channel]] "osrs soa" to find a partner before deciding.)}}
<choose>
<option>
{{:Shield of Arrav/Quick guide/Phoenix Gang}}
{{:Shield of Arrav/Quick guide/Black Arm Gang}}</option>
<option>
{{:Shield of Arrav/Quick guide/Black Arm Gang}}
{{:Shield of Arrav/Quick guide/Phoenix Gang}}</option>
</choose>

===Finishing up===
{{Checklist|*Take your half of the shield to [[Curator Haig Halen]], located in the [[Varrock Museum]].
*Trade your half of the certificate with your partner. '''([[Ironmen]]: Use the certificate halves on your partner)'''
*Use both halves of the certificate on each other to make a completed [[Certificate (Shield of Arrav)|certificate]].
*Take the certificate to [[King Roald]] in the castle to receive your reward.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
